name: Publish attempts abandoned
description: A publish attempt that was started and never confirmed. Any of these is worth looking at: it is the shape of a crash mid-publish, which the recovery sweep is supposed to adopt or retry.

name: Work nobody can retry
description: Jobs that ran out of retries and now need a person. A sustained trickle is a bug; a spike is an outage.

name: Webhook processing lag
description: How far behind we are on what merchants changed in their stores. Lag here means the catalogue we are writing from is stale.

name: Kill switches tripped
description: Every automatic pause, as it happened. This is the record after the fact — the pause itself is a row in our own database, decided by our own code.

name: Reliability
description: Publishing that never confirmed, work nobody can retry, how far behind the store change feed is, and every switch that went up.

name: A publish attempt was abandoned
description: Fires on any occurrence. A half-made post on a merchant's store is the failure two-phase publishing exists to prevent.

name: Work has been stuck in the dead-letter queue for an hour
description: One dead-lettered job is a bug report; an hour of them is an outage nobody has noticed.

name: Store changes are more than an hour behind
description: At this lag the catalogue we are writing from is stale, and the drift sweep has not caught up.
